Name: TV with Stand (SDV1.6)
Author: tikamin557
Description:
[size=4][quote][center]This mod is a conversion and modification to the FF and CP version of a mod that was previously released as a mod that works with DGA. (Repealed [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14722]DGA version[/url]﻿﻿)[/center][/quote][/size]
[color=#ffff00][size=3]There are a few changes from the old DGA version.[/size][/color][color=#ffff00][size=3]
We ask that those who have previously used the DGA version also read the description.[/size][/color]

[color=#00ff00][size=4]In addition to "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿", "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23458]Furniture Framework[/url]" and "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url]" are also required mods.[/size][/color]

This mod was created during the "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24922]Recessed Fish Tank (SDV1.6)[/url]" production process.
Use them together if you like, as they can be used together to expand the range of your customization.
[color=#00ffff]Of course, this mod can also be used by itself.[/color]

By default Robin sells some tv with stand.
In order to obtain the full range of tv with stands, you will need the "TV with Stand Catalogue" sold by Robin.
The tv with stand that appears in this catalog can be finely hidden from the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]ModConfig[/url] settings to make it easier to find what you need.
You can also change the appearance (table) of the catalog itself.

Each TV is all one tile deep, so they are less obtrusive and blend in with the interior!

[color=#00ff00][size=4]Compatibility with other mods.[/size][/color]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19675]Happy Home Designer[/url]
If installed, the “Happy Home Designer” furniture installation UI is available by accessing the dedicated catalog.


Currently available in English and Japanese.

Note: The images in Media are a mixture of those using the color reduction mod and vanilla color.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[size=3]We would like to express our utmost gratitude to "[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Leroymilo/about-me?gameId=1303]Leroymilo[/url]", the author of the "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23458]Furniture Framework[/url]", for making it possible to create custom TV sets, which was not possible with the CP alone after the DGA was discontinued![/size]
[size=5][center][color=#00ffff]Thank you so much!!!!![/color][/center][/size]----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
